scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:platform && bun run typecheck:legacy
scripts.typecheck:platform: bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run --parallel --filter '@bonne-garde/cli' --filter '@bonne-garde/registry' --filter '@bonne-garde/schema' typecheck
scripts.check:platform: vp check apps/cli packages/registry packages/schema scripts
scripts.check:legacy: vp check apps/api apps/spa apps/ssr apps/static packages/config packages/emails packages/ui
scripts.test: bun run test:platform && bun run test:legacy
scripts.test:platform: bun run test:scripts && bun run --parallel --filter '@bonne-garde/cli' --filter '@bonne-garde/registry' --filter '@bonne-garde/schema' test
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run intentions:lint && bun run registry:build
scripts.publish:cli:dry: bun scripts/pack-cli.ts && bun pm pack --cwd dist/npm/create-bonne-garde
